summary: Iteration 78 review: reels feed with text/image/video (kind=all), nav redesign (no Inicio), /map explore tabs, profile settings (language + explorar tarjetas + website), and /compose page. Backend + Frontend fully tested on preview @ 390x844.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing data-testid on the settings gear button in the profile header — added data-testid="profile-settings-btn" for testability

reel-sound-disc (music disc button in right rail) is rendered on text/image reels as well as videos. It is not in the required-to-hide list (mute/remix/sound-label/progress-bar), but for text/image reels there is no audio, so showing the disc is inconsistent. Consider wrapping it with `src && (...)` like the mute/sound-label buttons.

action_items: OPTIONAL: hide reel-sound-disc on text/image reels (wrap in `src && ...` inside ReelItem.jsx right rail).
critical_code_review_comments: ReelItem.jsx: right rail sound disc button lacks the `src && (...)` guard used for mute/sound-label/remix/progress — inconsistent UX on text/image reels.
MyProfilePage.jsx: gear button missing data-testid (fixed here). Other interactive icon buttons on the page also miss data-testid/aria-label; consider auditing.
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/pages/MyProfilePage.jsx (added data-testid=profile-settings-btn + aria-label to settings gear button)
seed_data_creation: Created one text post via /compose during testing (TEST_iter78_...). No cleanup performed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Iteration 78 requirements verified. Backend GET /api/posts/recommended-videos supports kind=all (mix of text/image/video) and default (video only). Frontend confirms: (1) / and /feed redirect to /reels; nav-home removed. (2) Reels feed shows mixed kinds (video/image/text) via ArrowDown scroll; direct link ?id=<textId> shows reel-text-<id>, ?id=<imgId> shows reel-image-<id>. (3) On text/image reel-item containers: mute-toggle, remix-btn, sound-label, progress-bar are correctly absent; like/comments/save/share present and working. Double-tap on text reel body toggles like (verified: unliked → double-clicked → heart fills red & count +1). (4) /map has map-tab-map + map-tab-explore; explore tab opens map-explore-panel with cards-explorer + search (filters items), 10 filter chips, compact/grid/list view toggles, compact-card-* items; URL becomes /map?explore=1; direct /map?explore=1 works; map-explore-close closes it. (5) Profile settings panel (open via new profile-settings-btn) shows profile-explore-cards-link (→ /map?explore=1), profile-language-toggle (ES↔EN switches label), profile-website-link. (6) nav-create → Publicación → /compose (compose-page) → submit navigates to /reels?id=<newId> with reel-text-<newId> visible & 'Publicación creada' toast. (7) Siguiendo/En vivo tabs render without crashes. Profile reels /profile/<uid>/reels renders 'Reels del perfil'. Only cosmetic finding: reel-sound-disc button remains visible on text/image reels — see action_items.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs blocking the requirements. The initial page-wide selector check falsely reported mute/remix present on text/image reels; scoping to `[data-testid=reel-item-<id>]` confirmed they only exist on adjacent VIDEO reels in the DOM, not on text/image ones (ReelItem.jsx correctly guards those elements with `src && (...)`).
